root.label: Colleen Slemmer murdered by Christa Pike

events.label: Colleen Slemmer murdered by Christa Pike

slots.name: case participants
slots.sentence: Pike, Tadaryl Shipp and Shadolla Peterson were all students at Jobs Corps, a training program in Knoxville, Tennessee, when they lured Slemmer, a classmate, into the woods on Jan. 12, 1995.

slots.name: birth date
slots.sentence: Born on Sept. 20, 1975, Slemmer was raised in Orange Park, Florida, but moved to Knoxville to enroll in Jobs Corps, according to court records and the Nashville Tennessean, part of the USA TODAY Network.

events.label: Shadolla Peterson pleads guilty and receives probation

slots.name: probation term
slots.sentence: Peterson, the other individual involved in the crime, pleaded guilty to being an accessory and received a sentence of six years probation, per court documents.

slots.name: jail credit
slots.sentence: She took a plea deal from prosecutors and received credit for 460 days in jail, according to a 1996 article in the Knoxville News Sentinel, part of the USA TODAY Network.

slots.name: conviction count
slots.sentence: Shipp was convicted of first-degree murder and conspiracy to commit first-degree murder at a 1997 trial.

slots.name: prison sentence
slots.sentence: He was sentenced to life and 25 years in prison, according to court and inmate records.

slots.name: age at crime
slots.sentence: Because Shipp was 17 at the time of the crime, he could not get the death penalty under state law.
